newsitem.title: USA: Electroglas sees taking $23 mil R&D charge.
newsitem.headline: Electroglas sees taking $23 mil R&D charge.

text.p: SANTA CLARA, Calif., April 24 (Reuter) Electroglas Inc said Thursday its net income for the first quarter of 1997 was $26,000, versus $11.2 million in the same quarter last year -- as sales for the 1997 quarter barely reached half the level seen in 1996.
As a result, the company said its earnings per share for the 1997 first quarter were nil, compared with $0.62 per share recorded last year.

And it said it expects to take a charge of about $23 million for acquired in-process research and development in connection with its planned acquisition of Knights Technology Inc, a specialized software company.
Electroglas, which announced the purchase agreement last month, said Thursday it intends to close the deal during the current quarter ending June 30.
It said said revenues for the 1997 quarter ended March 31, 1997, were $25.6 million compared with $51.8 million in the comparable period last year.
Even so, the company said its latest quarterly earnings were a 29 percent improvement from the immediate prior quarter, thanks to an upswing in bookings that began in late 1996.

"The worst part of the current equipment economic cycle seems to be behind us," said company CEO Curt Wozniak, who added, "the improvement in the semiconductor industry has led to a resurgence of orders in the equipment industry."
